title: Never Been To A Mall?
content: I am astonished. I live in a rustic place. It's like living on the dark side of the moon. I was in a store this this morning. The cashier was a sweet girl between 18 and 20 years old. She said that I reminded her of a teenage girl in a mall. I was surprised and happy about the "haul" I got! Then, she told me she'd never been in a mall, except for once on a school trip! I couldn't believe my ears. She's been deprived of a formative experience. I forgot to ask if she has MallWorld dreams. If she doesn't, where can she hang out while asleep? :)
